# apim_authz_entity (Resource)

An authorization entity, a principal or a resource that policies name, with its parents, attributes and PDP gateway targets. Deleting an entity deletes the RESOURCE entities that have it as a parent, and detaches the PRINCIPAL ones; APIM refuses with a `413` a delete that would remove or detach more entities than its cascade limit. Requires APIM 4.14 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apim_authz_entity" "travel" {
  hrid        = "travel-group"
  entity_id   = "travel"
  kind        = "PRINCIPAL"
  entity_type = "Group"
  targets     = [apim_authz_pdp.orders_eu.routing_scope]
}

resource "apim_authz_entity" "agents" {
  hrid        = "agents-group"
  entity_id   = "agents"
  kind        = "PRINCIPAL"
  entity_type = "Group"
  attributes = jsonencode({
    department = "travel"
  })
  # Members of the travel group. The platform reports parents and targets
  # sorted: another order plans no change.
  parents = [
    {
      entity_type = apim_authz_entity.travel.entity_type
      entity_id   = apim_authz_entity.travel.entity_id
    }
  ]
  targets = [apim_authz_pdp.orders_eu.routing_scope]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `entity_id` (String) Id of the entity in policies, without its type: `postman-studio.read_wiki_structure`, not
`MCPTool::"postman-studio.read_wiki_structure"`. Fixed at creation; held by one entity of the
environment.
- `entity_type` (String) Type of the entity, spelled the way the engine spells it: `Group`, not `group`; `MCPTool`, not
`mcptool`. Fixed at creation. A built-in type fixes the `kind`.
- `hrid` (String) A unique human readable id identifying this resource. Requires replacement if changed.
- `kind` (String) Whether the entity acts (`PRINCIPAL`) or is acted upon (`RESOURCE`). Fixed at creation. must be one of ["PRINCIPAL", "RESOURCE"]

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the entity is published to the PDP gateways it targets. Default: true
- `attributes` (String) The attributes of the entity, replaced whole on every apply. A key that starts with `_` is
reserved to the module and refused.
Parsed as JSON.
- `environment_id` (String) environment ID
- `organization_id` (String) organization ID
- `parents` (Attributes List) The entities this one is a member of; replaced whole on every apply (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--parents))
- `targets` (List of String) The PDP gateways the entity is published to, each as the gateway reports its routing scope, or
`default`, or `*` for every gateway. An empty list falls back to the default engine on every gateway. Not allowed on an `Action`
entity.
Default: []

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource UUID

<a id="nestedatt--parents"></a>
### Nested Schema for `parents`

Optional:

- `entity_id` (String) Id of the parent, under the same rule as an entity's `entityId`. Not Null
- `entity_type` (String) Canonical type of the parent. Not Null

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apim_authz_entity.agents
  id = jsonencode({
    environment_id  = "DEFAULT"
    hrid            = "agents-group"
    organization_id = "DEFAULT"
  })
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apim_authz_entity.agents '{"environment_id": "DEFAULT", "hrid": "agents-group", "organization_id": "DEFAULT"}'
```
